_comment: MANUAL STEP (HFY-TSK-067): the frontend bucket is not managed by app-stack.yaml. Apply once with: aws s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket harrisonfamily-frontend --cors-configuration file://infrastructure/cloudformation/media-bucket-cors.json (strip this _comment key first). Browsers PUT presigned post photos directly to S3 under uploads/posts/<ulid>/ (HFY-R58: never media/, which the ETL sync mirrors with --delete; the presigned URL signs Content-Type, so the browser must send the exact Content-Type the API returned). Uploads are served back through the CloudFront /uploads/* behavior (scripts/infra/add-uploads-behavior.sh) with the nosniff + sandbox CSP response headers policy from app-stack.yaml, members-only and Cache-Control private, no-store once scripts/infra/add-data-gate-behaviors.sh has gated it. The PUT itself goes straight to S3, not through CloudFront.
